elements.element: Commerce One must maintain commercial general liability insurance with a limit of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no commercial general liability insurance requirement.

elements.element: Commerce One must maintain commercial general liability insurance with an aggregate limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no commercial general liability aggregate requirement.

elements.element: Commerce One must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause requires only USD 1,000,000 of professional liability insurance.

elements.element: If Commerce One processes Customer Data, Commerce One must maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: Although the rendered clause imposes cyber and privacy coverage without qualification, it requires only USD 2,000,000 rather than USD 5,000,000.

elements.element: Commerce One must maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no workers' compensation insurance requirement.

elements.element: Commerce One must provide certificates of insurance upon request.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no obligation to provide certificates of insurance upon request.

result.reason: The operative addition exactly implements the two fallback coverage requirements but omits or falls below every other preferred requirement. It does not alter the existing bankruptcy or integration terms and adds no unrelated obligation. Drafting quality is reduced because the unnumbered insurance provision is inserted after the agreement's execution language, making its placement structurally awkward, though the obligation itself is clear.
